positions.name: PallasineChecklistGovernance
positions.frame: how is the Pallasine checklist established as the governing onboarding procedure?
positions.why: Both expressions establish the Pallasine checklist's institutional authority over onboarding: src-1 as a universal mandate ('Every new hire completes … in their first week') and src-2 as a governance succession ('It replaced the old wiki page last quarter'). The relational dimension reads both as authority-ranking; the value dimension reads both as conservation (order and stability). A conviction gradient exists — src-1 performs a settled operational rule (decision-level) while src-2 supplies an informational historical claim (claim-level) — but both serve the same directional read of the checklist's governance position from complementary angles, one enacting the mandate and the other narrating its displacement of a predecessor.
